text.card: A red giant 7,078 parsecs away, 21 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 13, give 1.24 solar masses and 20.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,593 K at its surface.
